About membership
What is the Collectors Club?
A private intelligence layer for serious collectors. Monthly briefings, priority access, and direct access to Adrielle's advisory network — structured around how you actually collect, not how institutions say you should.
Can I cancel?
Yes. Cancel at any time through your member portal. Your access continues through the end of the billing period.
How does billing work?
Your card is charged monthly on the date you joined. Stripe handles all payment processing — Codex never stores your card details.
